items.title: 르네사스, 피지컬 AI 전담팀 출범…휴머노이드 반도체 공략 본격화

items.title: Palestinians in Gaza dread another winter with nowhere safe to shelter

items.snippet: 북한이 14일 동해상에서 잠수함발사전략순항미사일(SLCM) 2종을 시험발사했다고 15일 밝혔다. 신형 전술핵공격잠수함에서 핵탄두를 탑재할 수 있는 SLCM의 첫 수중 시험발사에 나서면서 한층 고도화된 수중 핵기습 역량을 과시한 것이다. 북한은 15일 조선중앙통신을 통해 “미사일총국은 14일 동해에서 두 종의 잠수함발사전략순항미사일을 시험발사했다”고 보도했다. 북한이 공개한 발사 사진에 따르면 3000t급 전술핵잠수함인 ‘김군옥영웅함’으로 추정되는 잠수함이 수직발사관(VLS)과 어뢰발사관에서 소형 핵탄두 장착이 가능한 SLCM 2종을 연달아 쏘는 ‘섞어 쏘기’를 했다. 북한이 SLCM을 VLS를 통한 ‘콜드론치(발사 후 공중 점화)’ 방식으로 발사하는 장면을 공개한 것은 처음이다. 북한이 이번 시험발사에 사용한 미사일은 소형 핵탄두 장착이 가능...

items.title: 주간 아파트 가격 동향 공표 축소 가능성에… 野 “불편한 통계 자체 줄이려는건가” 비판
items.snippet: 15일 국회 국토교통위원회의 한국부동산원·주택도시보증공사(HUG) 등에 대한 국정감사에서는 전세 가격 상승과 전세 물량 축소를 둘러싼 공방이 오갔다. 국민의힘 김정재 의원은 “실거주 의무를 강화하는 등 정부가 전세의 씨를 마르게 하는 정책을 획일적으로 구사해 왔다”며 “전세제도를 장려하고 부활시키는 전월세 안심신탁은 정부 정책과 완전히 상반된다”고 지적했다. 전월세 안심신탁은 임차인의 전세금을 HUG가 보관·운용하고 임대인에게 매월 수익을 지급하는 제도다. 최인호 HUG 사장은 “(신탁은) 갭투자(세 끼고 매매)가 원천적으로 불가능해 정부의 전세 정책과 부합한다”며 “세입자 입장에서 매우 유리한 제도”라고 반박했다. 부동산원의 주간 아파트 가격 동향에 대한 지적도 이어졌다. 국민의힘 정희용 의원은 이헌욱 한국부동산원장이 6월 기자간담회에서 통...

items.title: 브런슨, 韓 작전운용능력 재검증 시사… 전작권 불협화음 커져
items.snippet: 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관(한미연합사령관 겸직)이 전시작전통제권 전환 조건이 변경됐다고 언급하자 우리 군이 ‘골대를 옮긴다’고 받아치면서 전작권 전환을 두고 한미 군 당국이 충돌했다. 브런슨 사령관은 전작권 전환을 위한 역량 재검증이 필요하다는 뜻을 내비친 것은 물론 전작권 전환 이후 한국군이 주도하기로 한 미래연합사 구조에 대해서도 “어떤 모습이 될지 모른다”고 말했다. 이재명 대통령이 지난달 유엔 총회 계기 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과의 정상회담에서 처음으로 전작권 전환 필요성을 제기한 이후 브런슨 사령관이 ‘총대’를 메고 전환 작업에 제동을 거는 모양새에 대한 정부 내 반감 기류도 감지된다.● “조건 변했고, 지켜야 할 새 기준 생겨”브런슨 사령관은 14일(현지 시간) 워싱턴 싱크탱크 ‘골드 국제전략연구소’ 주최 세미나에서 “신문을...

items.title: 극초음속 발사-ICBM 도면 이어… 北, 수중 핵타격 능력도 과시
items.snippet: 북한이 14일 동해에서 핵탄두를 탑재할 수 있는 잠수함발사순항미사일(SLCM) 2종을 시험발사했다. 최근 잇달아 극초음속미사일 발사와 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM) 다탄두 도면을 공개한 데 이어 수중 핵타격 능력까지 과시한 것이다. 북한이 잠수함에서 서로 다른 2종의 순항미사일을 ‘섞어쏘기’로 쏜 것은 처음이다. 한국과 주일미군을 겨냥한 핵 운반 수단을 다변화해 한미의 탐지·요격망을 압박하고, 북-미 대화에 앞서 핵보유국 지위를 굳히려는 행보로 풀이된다. 15일 북한 조선중앙통신은 전날 SLCM 2종을 시험발사했다며 “해군의 전략적 임무 수행 능력을 숙련시키는 데 기여했다”고 주장했다. 미사일의 명칭과 비행거리, 시간 등 세부 제원은 밝히지 않았다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장의 참관 여부도 언급하지 않았다. 공개된 사진에는 3000t급 ‘김군옥영웅함...

items.title: 수보회의 첫 참석한 임광현 “쓴소리 익명 제안 창구 설치”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 대통령 취임 500일을 하루 앞둔 15일 직접 대통령비서실장 이임식과 임명식을 주재하며 2기 청와대를 본격적으로 가동했다. 이 대통령은 이날 임광현 신임 비서실장이 참석하는 첫 수석보좌관회의에서 “비서실장을 중심으로 언제든지 충분히 소통하고 토론하면서 어떻게 하면 청와대가 대한민국의 더 나은 미래를 위해 기여할 수 있을지를 함께 고민해 주시기 바란다”고 당부했다. 전날 비례대표 초선 의원, 국세청장 출신인 임 실장이 임명되면서 일각에서 경기·성남 라인의 영향력이 강해지는 것 아니냐는 우려가 나오자 비서실장 힘 싣기에 나섰다는 해석이 나온다. 임 실장은 이날 첫 비서실장 지시사항으로 “직급에 관계없이 국가와 민생을 위해 쓴소리를 전할 수 있도록 비서실장실에 익명 제안 창구를 설치하라”고 지시했다고 청와대 강유정 수석대변인이 서면...

items.title: 李, 김지용 청문회 하루만에 중수청장 임명 재가
items.snippet: 국회 행정안전위원회가 15일 김지용 중대범죄수사청(중수청)장 후보자(사진)에 대한 인사청문 경과보고서를 채택했다. 다만 국민의힘뿐 아니라 김 후보자에 대한 문제를 제기해온 더불어민주당 일부 의원들도 ‘부적격’ 의견을 냈다. 이재명 대통령은 이날 김 후보자 임명안을 재가했다고 청와대 강유정 수석대변인이 밝혔다. 국회 행안위는 이날 오후 전체회의를 열고 김 후보자에 대한 인사청문 경과보고서 채택의 건을 여야 합의로 의결했다. 행안위는 인사청문 경과보고서에 “검찰 출신인 후보자가 중수청장으로 임명될 경우 기존 검찰의 수사 관행이 답습되고 형사사법체계 개편의 취지가 훼손될 우려가 있다”는 부적격 의견과 “후보자가 관련 논란에 대한 판단 근거와 경위를 소명하였다는 점과 형사사법체계 개편의 취지를 존중하겠다는 의지를 표명했다”는 적격 의견을 함께 명시했...

items.title: “신앙인 소명으로 나눔 실천” 자소서로 합격… 건설근로자공제회 성남라인 이사장 논란
items.snippet: 이른바 ‘경기·성남 라인’ 인사들이 공공기관장으로 임명된 것을 둘러싼 논란이 확산되고 있다. 야권에서는 관련 경력이나 전문성이 부족한 ‘낙하산’ 인사들이 임명됐다고 비판하고 있다. 15일 국회 기후에너지환경노동위원회 소속 국민의힘 나경원 의원실이 건설근로자공제회로부터 제출받은 자료에 따르면 장건 이사장은 올해 4월 증권사 전무 출신 경쟁 후보를 제치고 이사장으로 임명됐다. 건설근로자공제회는 일용직 건설근로자를 위한 퇴직공제금 등을 운용하는 고용노동부 산하 기관인데, 시민단체 출신으로 기금 운용 경험이 없는 장 이사장이 임명된 것. 장 이사장은 자기소개서에서도 “기독신앙인으로서 ‘예수라면 어떻게 할 것인가’라는 소명을 갖고 삶의 현장에서 사회적 약자와 소외계층에 대한 섬김과 나눔을 통한 사랑을 실천하고자 애써 왔다”며 직무와 무관한 내용을 내세...

items.title: 與 “오세훈, 서울 집값 상승 남탓만” 吳 “정부 실거주 정책이 문제”
items.snippet: 15일 국회 행정안전위원회의 서울시 국정감사에서는 서울 집값 상승의 책임을 놓고 여당 의원들과 국민의힘 소속 오세훈 서울시장이 정면으로 맞붙었다. 더불어민주당 의원들은 “민간 공급에 치중한 나머지 공공주택 같은 서민이나 청년을 위한 정책 의지가 약한 것 아닌가”라며 서울시가 공공주택 공급에 소홀했다고 지적했다. 반면 오 시장은 “정부의 실거주 중심 정책이 전월세 공급을 위축시키고, 주택 매수 수요를 자극했다”고 맞섰다. 또 민주당은 한강버스 사업 과정의 리베이트 의혹을 제기하며 서울시장 5선에 성공해 야권의 차기 대선 주자로 부상한 오 시장을 몰아세웠다.● 與 “공공주택 공급 부진” vs 吳 “정부 정책 탓” 민주당 이상식 의원은 이날 서울시청에서 열린 국감에서 “올해 (서울시의 주택 공급) 목표가 거의 1만 호인데 9월 말 기준으로 5000...

items.title: 청해부대 임무 오만만까지 확대 추진
items.snippet: 정부가 올해 말 임무가 종료되는 청해부대의 파견을 연장하면서 임무 범위를 확대하는 방안을 추진 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 정부는 호르무즈 해협 파병과는 선을 긋고 있지만, 청해부대 임무 강화가 이재명 대통령이 언급해 온 ‘호르무즈 기여’ 방안이 될 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 국방부는 15일 “최근 소말리아 아덴만 해역의 해적 활동이 예년 대비 급증하는 등 해당 지역의 안전 상황이 악화되고 있다”며 “청해부대 파견 동의안의 만료 이전, 연장 동의안 제출을 준비 중”이라고 밝혔다. 강신철 국방부 장관도 이날 국회 법제사법위원회의 국정감사에서 “청해부대의 임무, 파견 연장에 대한 부분들은 여러 가지로 다양하게 검토하고 있다”고 말했다. 일각에선 동의안에 아덴만 해역을 기본으로 하는 작전 범위를 호르무즈 해협 인근 오만만으로 넓히는 방안도 거론된다. 다...

items.title: 민주-국힘 지지율 오차범위내… 李정부 출범후 처음
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 지지율이 33%, 국민의힘이 28%로 집계되면서 양당 지지율 격차가 이재명 정부 출범 이후 처음으로 오차범위 안으로 좁혀졌다. 엠브레인퍼블릭, 케이스탯리서치, 코리아리서치, 한국리서치가 12일부터 14일까지 전국 성인 남녀 1000명을 조사해 15일 발표한 10월 셋째 주 전국지표조사(NBS, 무선전화 면접 100%, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 민주당 지지율은 33%, 국민의힘은 28%로 조사됐다. 직전 조사(10월 첫째 주)에선 민주당 35%, 국민의힘 25%였다. items.title: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
items.abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to 100mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange meta...

items.title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
items.abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). The comparison between the QFT and the classical FFT reveals that, for any quantum workload operating under a polynomially bounded sampling regime, the crossover in energy consumption occurs at smaller problem size...

items.snippet: 지난 13일 전북 전주에서 별거 중인 아내를 흉기로 살해한 70대는 스토킹과 가정폭력으로 접근·연락금지 명령이 내려진 상태였고, 숨진 아내는 앞서 8차례나 경찰에 신고해 도움을 요청했던 것으로 15일 드러났다. 이처럼 경찰이 위험 신호를 파악하고도 참극을 막지 못한 흉악범죄가 잇따르고 있다. 최근 1주일 사이 5건이나 발생했다. 12일 제주에서는 지난해부터 스토킹과 성폭력 등을 4차례 신고한 40대 여성이 과거 연인이었던 60대 남성에게 살해됐다. 피해 여성은 당시 경찰에 구조요청을 할 수 있는 스마트워치를 차고 있었지만 가해자가 뜯어내 사용하지 못했다. 같은 날 서귀포에서는 이혼 소송 중인 아내와 양육권 분쟁을 벌이던 40대 남성이 4세 딸과 함께 숨진 채 발견됐다. 아내는 열흘 전 “딸이 위험하다”고 알렸지만, 경찰은 112로 정식 접수된...

items.title: 시간별 투표자 수 허위 입력… 지역 선관위 25곳 추가 확인
items.snippet: 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하는 선거관리위원회 특별검사팀(특별검사 이태한)은 전국 30개 시군구 선관위에서 6·3 지방선거 당시 시간대별 투표자수를 허위로 입력한 사실을 확인했다고 15일 밝혔다. 종전 검경 합동수사본부가 확인한 5곳에 더해 전국 25곳에서 같은 문제가 드러났다는 것이다. 특검팀은 이날 지역 선관위가 특정 업체에 선거물품 보관계약 특혜를 준 정황도 포착해 압수수색에 나섰다.

items.title: 검찰미래위 조사단 “위례 비리 수사, 위법성 없었다” 결론
items.snippet: 과거 검찰의 수사권 남용 의혹을 조사 중인 검찰인권존중미래위원회(검찰미래위) 진상조사단이 15일 이재명 대통령이 기소된 위례 신도시 개발 비리와 서해 공무원 피격, 문재인 정부 부동산 통계 조작 등 3건에 대한 검찰 수사에는 문제가 없었다고 결론 내렸다. 하지만 검찰미래위는 조사단에 추가 조사를 요구한 것으로 확인됐다. 법조계에서는 “검찰미래위가 추가 조사를 해서라도 검찰 수사의 문제점을 찾으려는 것 같다”는 반응이 나왔다.

items.title: “전자발찌, 가해자가 피해자 접근하면 자동으로 경찰에 경보 울리게 해야”
items.snippet: 경찰은 최근 수년간 가정폭력·교제폭력·스토킹 등 ‘관계성 범죄’가 강력 범죄로 번지는 것을 막기 위해 각종 대책을 내놨다. 하지만 최근 1주일 새 잇따른 흉악 범죄에서는 기존 대책의 허점이 고스란히 드러났다는 지적이 나온다. 피해자가 여러 차례 경찰에 신고했는데도 위험 신호를 제대로 포착하지 못했고, 스마트워치나 전자발찌 등 보호 장치가 있었는데도 범행을 막지 못했기 때문이다.

items.snippet: 15일 오전 서울 강남구 양재천 벼농사 체험 학습장에서 ‘양재천 가을맞이 벼 베기 체험’ 행사가 열렸다. 아이들이 ‘키’를 이용해 쭉정이를 골라내고 있다. 이날 200여 명이 벼 베기, 탈곡, 볏짚 묶기 등을 체험했다.

items.title: 7년간 치료 이겨내고… 바다로 돌아가는 붉은바다거북 ‘럭키’
items.snippet: 15일 오전 제주 서귀포시 광치기해변에서 붉은바다거북 ‘럭키’가 바다로 방류되고 있다. 럭키는 2019년 8월 제주 해변에서 그물과 낚시 도구에 걸려 상처를 입은 채 발견돼 해양 동물 전문 구조 기관인 아쿠아플라넷 제주에서 7년간 치료받은 끝에 이날 방류됐다.

items.title: “노후화 된 공업 지역… AI·로봇 산업 거점으로”
items.snippet: 서울 영등포구에는 여의도 금융가와 문래동 철공소 거리, 아파트 단지 등이 섞여 있다. 최근엔 데이터센터 건립을 둘러싼 갈등도 벌어지고 있다. 조유진(66) 영등포구청장은 지난 13일 본지 인터뷰에서 “영등포 곳곳의 낡은 공업 지역을 AI(인공지능), 로봇 산업 거점으로 바꾸겠다”고 말했다. 조 구청장은 국회의원 보좌관, 대통령비서실 행정관 출신으로 지난 6·3 영등포구청장 선거에 더불어민주당 후보로 출마해 당선됐다.

items.title: 女교원 25% 지침에, 국립의대 “여교수님 어디 없나요”
items.snippet: 서울대학교 의과대학 생리학 교실은 지난 3월 내분비대사 분야 신규 전임 교원(대학에 정식 임용된 교수) 채용 공고를 내면서 ‘여성만 지원할 수 있다’는 조건을 달았다. 충북대 의대 신경과학 분야도 올해 하반기 전임 교원 채용 조건을 ‘여성’으로 명시했는데, 지원자가 ​1명뿐이었다고 한다.

items.title: 선선한 가을 날씨… 축제 즐기기 딱 좋네
items.snippet: 10월은 축제의 계절이다. 22일 경남 사천에선 ‘2026 사천 에어쇼’가 막을 올린다. 공군 특수 비행팀 ‘블랙이글스’가 곡예 비행을 선보인다. 국산 초음속 전투기 KF-21, 지대공 미사일 천궁 등 최신 무기도 볼 수 있다. 우주항공방위산업전도 함께 열린다. 행사는 25일까지다. 경북 칠곡에선 15일 ‘칠곡 낙동강 평화 축제’가 개막했다. 올해 주제는 ‘소년, 소년병이 되다’다. 군복을 입고 부교(浮橋)를 건너는 등 소년병 체험을 할 수 있다. 행사는 18일까지 이어진다.

items.title: 리디아 고·김주형·최예림…‘73승 名코치’가 밝힌 비결
items.snippet: 고진영을 여자 골프 세계 1위로 만들었고, 리디아 고(뉴질랜드)와는 올림픽 금메달을 합작했다. 깊은 부진에 빠져 있던 김주형이 2년 9개월 만에 PGA(미 프로골프) 투어 우승컵을 들고 최근 아시안게임 금메달까지 거머쥔 데에도 그의 도움을 빼놓을 수 없다. 국내 최고의 골프 교습가로 꼽히는 이시우(45) 코치다.

items.title: RTX 5090 disappears from Nvidia marketplace amid reports of a production halt
items.snippet: Micro Center has reclassified Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics cards as 'Not Carried,' and almost all units are out of stock at its stores.

items.title: “내가 벌써 백살이라니? 하하하”… 여전히 패기 넘쳤다
items.snippet: 15일 서울 고덕동에 대낮부터 ‘별’들이 쏟아졌다. 이정재, 이영애, 이재, 박찬욱, 김무열 등 한류 스타를 비롯해 임권택, 박근형, 박정자, 손숙, 고은아, 정혜선, 백일섭, 유인촌, 유동근, 전인화, 박상원, 최명길, 인순이, 배창호, 김수철, 박찬호, 정준호 등 문화예술계 명사 100여 명이 운집했다. 영화계 ‘큰별’이자 어른인 신영균 선생의 백수(白壽)를 축하하기 위해서다.

items.title: [플라자] 서울총장포럼·관훈클럽 업무협약 체결
items.snippet: 서울총장포럼과 관훈클럽은 15일 대학 교육과 현장 저널리즘의 연계를 강화하기 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다. 이에 따라 내년부터 관훈클럽 회원들이 서울총장포럼 소속 39개 대학에서 자신의 전문 분야와 취재 경험을 살려 정규 강의나 특강을 할 수 있는 시스템이 마련된다.

items.title: 방미통위, KBS 이사 2명 임명 제청… 방문진·EBS 이사도 각 2명 임명
items.snippet: 방송미디어통신위원회(방미통위)는 15일 제42차 전체 회의에서 이강덕 관훈클럽정신영기금 이사장과 장한식 전 KBS비즈니스 사장을 한국방송공사(KBS) 이사로 대통령에게 임명 제청하기로 했다. 또 오정환 전 공정언론국민연대 공동대표와 정재욱 법무법인 태원 변호사를 방송문화진흥회(방문진) 이사로, 박기완 전 KBS 원주방송국장과 조한제 전 벡스코 상임감사를 EBS 이사로 임명하기로 했다. 6명 모두 국민의힘 추천 인사다. 방미통위는 아울러 EBS 이사회가 임명 제청한 김장환 전 KBS 대구방송총국장을 EBS 감사로 임명하기로 의결했다. 방문진·EBS 이사와 EBS 감사의 임명일은 오는 19일이다.

items.title: [알립니다] 우리 아이 출생 소식 액자에 담아 간직하세요
items.snippet: 조선일보에 실린 아기 출생 소식, 본인이나 지인의 인터뷰·사진 기사를 영원히 추억으로 간직하세요. 조선일보는 독자가 원하는 신문 지면을 그대로 고급 액자에 담아 드리는 ‘조선일보 리프린트’ 서비스를 합니다. 매주 ‘아이가 행복입니다’ 지면에 소개된 한 가족을 추첨해 리프린트를 선물로 드립니다. 지난 2일 ‘우리 아기가 태어났어요’ 코너에 실린 김태리 양이 이번 주 주인공입니다. 자세한 내용은 홈페이지(reprint.chosun.com)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

items.title: 직원 지방 이사에… 재택근무 허용하고 현지 사무실 마련했죠
items.snippet: 한 살 아이를 키우는 김승희 화정엔지니어링 경영기획부 과장은 지난 4월 1년간의 육아휴직을 마치고 복직했다. 복직과 동시에 육아기 근로시간 단축을 신청했지만, 아이가 자주 아파 출근하기 어려운 날도 있었다. 그럴 때마다 회사는 재택근무를 허용했다. 김 과장은 “단축 근무 중에도 아이가 아프면 흔쾌히 재택근무를 허용해줘 육아와 일을 병행하는 데 큰 도움이 됐다”고 했다. 휴직 전 맡았던 업무도 그대로 이어가고 있다.

items.title: [우리 아기가 태어났어요] 이은빈·홍지명 아들 이준 외
items.snippet: 온 가족에게 기쁨을 안겨 준 아기의 탄생을 알려주세요. 홈페이지 주소 입력창에 아가야안녕.com이라고 입력하면 됩니다. 매일유업 육아 정보 사이트 매일아이(maeili.com)를 통해서도 접속할 수 있습니다. 추첨을 통해 출산 소식과 사진이 지면에 실린 가족에게는 ①케이크 구매권 ②엄마와 아이를 위한 매일두 포인트 3만원 ③출산 소식을 생일 날짜 본지 1면에 담은 PDF 파일 ④조선일보 1개월 무료 구독권을 드립니다. 당첨자 중 한 가족을 선정하여 해당 지면을 고급 프레임에 담아 제공하는 조선일보 리프린트도 제작해 드립니다. 홈페이지에서는 균형 영양식 메디웰 2만원 할인 혜택도 드리고 있습니다.

LG전자 디자인연구소장으로 근무하면서 초콜릿폰, 프라다폰, 올레드(OLED) TV, 노트북 그램(gram) 같은 디자인 개발을 주도했다. 이후 홍익대 산업미술대학원 산업디자인 교...

items.title: 배우고, 경험하고, 소통하고… “우리 아이디어는 현실이 된다”
items.snippet: 서울디자인재단(대표이사 차강희)은 디자인 전공 대학생에게 산업 현장의 실무 경험과 전시 기회를 제공해 이들의 성장을 지원하는 ‘대학 협업 프로그램’을 운영하고 있다. 재단은 오는 14~18일 서울 동대문디자인플라자(DDP) 아트홀에서 ‘2026 DDP디자인페어’ 영디자이너(Young Designer) 특별관을 열고, 대학 협업 프로그램에 참여한 20개 팀의 부스를 꾸렸다. 디자인 전공 대학생 90여 명이 기업과 협업해 만든 디자인 작품을 공개한다.

items.snippet: 이탈리아 밀라노에 위치한 공과대학 폴리테크니코의 디자인 스쿨인 폴리디자인(POLI.design)의 안나 바바라(58) 학장이 18일 한국을 찾는다. 폴리디자인은 이탈리아를 대표하는 디자인 교육·연구 기관이다. 바바라 학장은 2023년부터 폴리디자인 회장을 맡아 디자인 교육과 연구, 국제 협력을 이끌고 있다.

items.title: ‘어떤 사회 문제 풀려했나’ ‘삶에 실제 변화 가져오나’… 전문가도 놓친 부분 짚어냈다
items.snippet: 지난 14일 서울 동대문디자인플라자(DDP) 서울디자인어워드 시상식에 특별한 심사단이 참여했다. 대학생 등 청년 200명으로 구성된 ‘영.크.크.(Young Creator Crew)’다. 영.크.크.는 서울디자인어워드 공식 서포터스로 올해 처음 꾸려진 팀이다. 이들은 세계 각국 디자이너의 발표를 듣고 올해 대상을 뽑는 투표에 참여했다. “환경을 위한 디자인인데 제작 과정에서도 자원을 아꼈나” “우리 일상에 어떤 영향을 미치나” 등의 질문을 던졌다. 한 심사위원은 “미처 생각하지 못한 부분을 청년들이 짚었다”고 했다.

items.title: Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures
items.abstract: The rapid development of quantum magnonics over the past decade has created a demand for magnetic materials that keep their magnon losses low at millikelvin temperatures and add functionality beyond that of the established iron garnets and ferromagnetic metals. The europium chalcogenides are natural candidates $-$ they are magnetic semiconductors whose moment of $7\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Eu$^{2+}$ ion stems from a half-filled $4f$ shell with zero orbital momentum, so that spin-orbit coupling and intrinsic damping are expected to be weak. Here we characterize an epitaxial film of the metamagnet EuSe on diamagnetic BaF$_2$ by magnetometry and broadband ferromagnetic resonance from 10 K down to 30 mK. Novel high-pressure silicon allotrope with quartz topology from first principles
items.abstract: A novel silicon allotrope, qtz Si, with quartz topology is proposed and investigated alongside four known allotropes (dia Si-I, lon Si-IV, bsn Si-II, and gsi Si-III) using first-principles density functional theory. qtz Si is found to exhibit the smallest atom-averaged volume (18.06 A3), highest density (2.582 g/cm3), highest bulk modulus (98 GPa), and highest maximum phonon frequency (16 THz) among the five, while showing the lowest shear modulus (37 GPa). All five allotropes are confirmed to satisfy the Born stability criteria and to display positive phonon frequencies throughout the Brillouin zone, i.e., they are mechanically and dynamically stable. Electronic structure calculations show that qtz Si is a semimetal with a vanishing gap, whereas dia Si and lon Si are semiconductors, and bsn and gsi allotropes are weakly metallic. items.title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
items.abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. However, their use remains limited due to complex multi-software workflows, interdependent physical parameters, and substantial theoretical expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. We show that LLM agents tested in our work, including frontier models such as Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, do not reliably construct MBPT workflows in one attempt, suggesting that correct setup requires expert knowledge and consistency that current models lack. items.title: Robust Data-Driven Controller Synthesis from Sampled and Uncertain Frequency Response Estimates using Integral Quadratic Constraints
items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel MIMO controller synthesis method that relies solely on frequency-domain data of discrete-time systems. The approach is based on an iterative design procedure using \emph{integral quadratic constraints} (IQCs). It generalizes existing data-driven methods that approximate semi-infinite IQC conditions by enforcing them on a finite set of measured frequency points. Such approximations do not provide guarantees on the continuous frequency axis and may fail to capture inter-frequency behavior. We address this limitation by formulating a convex optimization problem that preserves robustness guarantees over the entire frequency range. In particular, the proposed method explicitly accounts for inter-frequency behavior of both plant and controller, leading to certified robust stability and performance. items.title: The Reciprocal tau-Cell: A Log-Domain Circuit for On-Chip Learning
items.abstract: Training hardware by gradient descent requires a gradient to be computed using a separate backwards pass. If a circuit is reciprocal, meaning every connection is symmetric, the backward pass is the same network run a second time with the error as its input. The reciprocal tau-cell, a weak-inversion log-domain circuit, makes this practical in standard CMOS. Each cell is a current-mode leaky integrator with a built-in ReLU; each connection is two transistors whose signed strength is a ratio of bias currents. The equilibrium of the network is the solution to a convex program, and latching the cells that are off will hardware linearise the circuit, making its second run exactly linear. items.title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. items.abstract: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. items.abstract: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. items.abstract: Since scaling laws were introduced for modern LLMs (Kaplan et al., 2020), several works have extended them to account for quantization, tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on AI accelerators. We develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes, grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. Our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency, and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. To select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law, we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components, isolating those that most affect loss. items.title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
items.abstract: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. We calculated pair-creation energies of approximately 12.2, 6.5, 7.3, 3.10, and 16.7 eV/pair for AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2, respectively. The CSC architecture mitigates these contact-related artifacts, enabling the decoupling of interface states and shallow states. items.abstract: Four-level indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) 2T0C memory needs reliable state formation, sensing references, and a path from cell errors to digital weights. We analyze 107 measured DC transfer curves from 37 isolated IGZO transistors (W/L = 3/0.5 micrometers). Four gate-bias operating points inferred from the first sweep are evaluated on later sweeps of 35 devices. Device-resolved operating points reduce second-sweep across-device current standard deviation by 49.4-52.4%, yet retaining initial thresholds increases misclassified points from 37/140 to 55/140. Leave-one-device-out reference estimation gives 0/140 on the second sweep; freezing second-sweep thresholds yields 6/140 on the third. Sampling eight reference transistors on the third sweep gives a mean held-out error fraction of 0.15% over 2,000 selections, versus 4.33% with frozen thresholds on matched held-out devices. items.title: Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design
items.abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. items.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. items.abstract: A Muon Collider is one of the most attractive routes to multi-TeV lepton collisions, but it requires the accelerator and detector communities to solve a tightly coupled set of problems that have no close precedent in an operating collider. Muons must be produced, captured, cooled, accelerated, and collided before they decay. The detector must then extract clean physics from an environment dominated by decay products from the beamline. Artificial intelligence is not a substitute for accelerator physics, detector design, or engineering validation. It is, however, unusually well matched to several of the central obstacles: high-dimensional design spaces, expensive simulations, coupled subsystem trade-offs, and workflows that are currently too slow or too fragile to support broad design exploration. items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. items.title: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
items.abstract: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior. In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. DFIT captures high-level, semantically meaningful data that reflect the true dataflow of computation. Thes...

items.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. items.title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
items.abstract: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. items.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
items.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. items.abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. items.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. items.title: From Prompts to Silicon: Scaling LLM-Assisted Chip Design with the AI Hardware Design League
items.abstract: The semiconductor workforce shortage has renewed interest in making chip design accessible to students without conventional very-large-scale integration (VLSI) training. We present the AI Hardware Design League (AI-HDL), an international, project-based competition in which students use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and iteratively refine Verilog while simulation, synthesis, timing analysis, security review, and physical verification provide the engineering feedback needed to validate the result. Across two annual cycles, AI-HDL grew from 172 to 604 participants and from 40 to 108 teams, reaching 30 universities, six community colleges, and 19 countries. In the 2026 cohort, 68.7% of participants reported no prior Verilog experience. Twenty-two teams completed the four design phases and reached final evaluation. items.abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. items.abstract: Students often perceive scientific experiments as clean, straightforward procedures with predictable outcomes. Students' beliefs about the nature of experimental physics typically remain inconsistent through the initial stages of undergraduate education. In reality, experimental work in physics involves hands-on activities such as soldering circuits, assembling provisional setups, and building functional mock-ups from simple materials before reliable measurements can be achieved. To address this gap, we designed a laboratory activity in which students were completely involved in the experiment design, construction and operation with the final goal of measuring the speed of light with a low-cost and compact setup. items.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

items.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. items.title: Quantum-vortex excitons beyond band topology
items.abstract: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. Here, we explain how Coulomb phase matching stabilises a quantum-vortex exciton as the lowest bound state in flat Chern bands. Using a prototypical Yin--Yang kagome lattice, we demonstrate that increasing the spin--orbit coupling drives a transition of the lowest exciton from a quantum-vortex state to a zero-winding state, while leaving the band Chern numbers unchanged. We trace this behaviour to a gauge-invariant combination of exciton phase differences and Bloch-overlap phases that can reduce the Coulomb energy. items.abstract: Every trading day, money leaves some stocks and moves into others. MarketRank asks where that money concentrates and how the concentration shifts over time. It treats the market as a Markov chain whose states are stocks. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. items.title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. items.title: CacheFit: The Rising Cost of Cache Replacement and Constraint-Driven Redesign of Last-Level Cache Replacement Policies
items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. Without a model, cost has never been an objective a policy search could optimize. In practice, a policy is first selected in simulation for its IPC, and its cost is reduced later in RTL, after the algorithm is fixed. Cost thus enters the design too late to shape it. This paper asks what happens when cost is present from the start. We build CacheFit, the first policy-design loop for LLC replacement with circuit-level cost inside the search objective. CacheF...

Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. items.title: Hall conductance of dilute electrolytes from odd stochastic density functional theory
items.abstract: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. However, existing theories fail to quantitatively account for their measured Hall conductivities. To make progress toward such a theory, we develop a stochastic density functional framework for electrolytes in a magnetic field. This framework, which we dub odd SDFT, extends the celebrated stochastic density functional theory (SDFT) to incorporate transverse mobilities and chiral time-correlated noise. Using this framework, we calculate the Hall conductivity in the absence of hydrodynamic solvent effects through three approaches: (i) direct response, (ii) Green-Kubo relation, and (iii) a hybrid fluctuation-dissipation relation. items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV-decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. In-memory computing (IMC) architectures based on emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) are widely regarded as a promising solution for accelerating neural network training due to their high parallelism and low power consumption. However, the intrinsic non-idealities of eNVM devices can cause conductance updates to deviate from target values, thereby limiting the performance of on-chip training. To address this challenge, this paper presents a Non-ideality Optimized eNVM Accelerator (NOVA) architecture for on-chip training. Specifically, we first fabricate a two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET) and develop a conductance modulation behavioral model calibrated with experimental data. items.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
items.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of...

items.title: Optically Coupled Noise Spectroscopy Quantifies Defect Passivation in Monolayer MoS2 FETs
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers are promising materials for electronic and photonic applications, yet the performance of chemical vapour deposition grown samples is severely limited by native sulphur vacancies that introduce mid-gap trap states, degrade carrier mobility, and elevate electrical noise. Here we investigate octanethiol passivation of sulphur vacancies in monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors, combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy. Thiol treatment reduces the sulphur vacancy concentration from 7% to 4%, reducing the free electron density. Electrically, it increases the device resistance 35-fold while restoring gate switching with an on/off ratio of 10^4 and improving field-effect mobility from 1 to 5 cm^2/Vs. items.title: On-chip nanoplasma for adaptive electromagnetic protection
items.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor diodes have served as the primary switching elements in adaptive electromagnetic (EM) protection, yet their performance has been compromised by parasitic effects and thermal accumulation, rendering them inadequate against the rapidly evolving landscape of high-power microwave (HPM) threats. Here we show that on-chip nanoplasma switches (NPMS), composed of gallium nitride electrodes on silicon carbide substrates, exhibit superior radio frequency (RF) and thermal characteristics, positioning them as ideal field-driven switches in RF front-end protectors. By integrating NPMS into metasurfaces, antennas and circuit limiters, we achieve an adaptive response that ensures low-loss transmission for normal signals and high shielding against HPMs, while offering extended operating bandwidth and substantially higher tolerance than conventional solid-state devices...

items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media
items.abstract: The sign of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient has long been regarded as irrelevant to the direction of the Raman-induced soliton self-frequency shift. Yet the standard generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) predicts a frequency shift that depends on the sign of the nonlinearity, which leads to an unphysical blue shift in the defocusing case. We resolve this inconsistency by deriving the time-domain form of the photon-conserving GNLSE (pcGNLSE) from its established frequency-domain counterpart. The derivation reveals that photon-number conservation imposes two sign modifications relative to the standard GNLSE: the Raman-shift coefficient acquires the absolute value of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient in place of its signed counterpart, and the self-steepening-Raman dissipation term likewise carries an absolute-value prefactor rather than a signed one. items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. These states show that the non-Ohmic response emerges from voltage-driven percolation. Conduction is governed by how junctions are conne...

items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. items.title: Nanoscopic Multiplexing Optical Data Storage via Chip Fabrication
items.abstract: The accelerating growth of global data demands storage technologies combining high capacity, long lifetime and low energy consumption. Optical storage is attractive for archival applications, but conventional optical writing is constrained by diffraction-limited resolution and scalability, while thermal accumulation limits high-speed writing. Here we shift optical data writing from a serial optical process to a fabrication-defined process, in which lithographic masks govern where material modification occurs. Using patterned resist masks and ion implantation, we create fluorescent information voxels with nanoscale control over millimeter-scale areas. The platform supports multilevel and multidimensional encoding by independently encoding information in fluorescence intensity and wavelength. A machine-learning-assisted super-resolution reconstruction protocol is developed to recover infor...

items.title: Absorption and Phase-Contrast Microtomography Using Direct X-Ray Detection With Commercial Off-The-Shelf CMOS Sensors
items.abstract: This work presents high-resolution X-ray microtomography based on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) CMOS image sensors as direct detectors. The system uses a microfocus X-ray source in cone-beam geometry, enabling both absorption-contrast imaging, thanks to the sensor s intrinsic resolution, and phase-contrast imaging, by adjusting the object-to-sensor distance. A dynamic flat-field correction algorithm mitigates radiation-induced sensor degradation during long acquisitions. The setup provides voxel sizes from 3.9 microns to 5.2 microns, with an effective spatial resolution (FWHM) as fine as 9.6 microns in magnified phase-contrast mode (1.33x) and 21 microns in non-magnified absorption-contrast mode. Phase contrast enhances visualization of soft tissue boundaries that are difficult to visualize using absorption-contrast imaging in the same experimental configuration.

items.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models. Transaction-based network energy models were developed in 2009 to understand the evolution o...

items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. items.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing.
